items.title: Telegram Returns To Apple Watch With Native App Supporting Messages, GIFs And Video Playback
items.body:
Telegram is making a return to the Apple Watch with a native app that brings messaging, media playback and other core features back to Apple Inc.'s (NASDAQ:AAPL) smartwatch platform.



Telegram Launches Native Apple Watch App



On Tuesday, Telegram founder Pavel Durov announced the launch on X, writing, “A fully native Telegram app for Apple Watch is out.”
